What's new in 1.6.0:
• Restore 48K/128K .z80 and .sna snapshots to real ZX Spectrum hardware through audio. • Based on Daan Scherft/Oxidaan's MIT-licensed ZQLoader design and Z80 receiver. • Open snapshots locally, from ZIP files, or ZXInfo. • Select 10x–1x turbo speed, polarity, and 48/44.1 kHz; preferences are remembered. • Added snapshot tips, progress, warnings, and WAV export. • Fixed state restoration, waveform polarity, and controls after playback.
